name: Fifty Thirty Twenty Budget
description: Applies the 50/30/20 budgeting rule to the user's income, categorizing every expense as a need (50%), want (30%), or savings/debt repayment (20%). Produces a populated allocation table showing current spending against these targets with specific rebalancing recommendations. Use when the user asks about the 50/30/20 rule, wants a simple percentage-based budget, or needs help categorizing spending into needs, wants, and savings. Do NOT use for zero-based budgeting (use zero-based-budget), variable income budgets (use variable-income-budget), or investment allocation.
